title: Local Models & Custom Providers
description: --oss and --local-provider (ollama|lmstudio) point the same harness at a local model, and the model_providers table with its wire_api swaps the endpoint without touching the loop.

steps.annotation: --oss selects an open-source provider; --local-provider picks ollama or lmstudio. Without --oss it falls back to the config default or prompts to choose.

steps.content: resolve Config: model_provider = "ollama"; look up model_providers.ollama in config.toml
steps.annotation: Provider selection is config resolution: a provider id is chosen, then its entry in the model_providers table is read.
Each provider entry declares where to send traffic (base_url) and which protocol to speak (wire_api); the loop only sees a resolved client.
The task is identical to one run against OpenAI; the harness does not change because the endpoint did.

steps.content: I'll find the handler and add schema validation.
steps.annotation: The local model plans against the same tools, sandbox, and instructions.
Tool calls run under the same resolved sandbox policy regardless of which provider produced them.
Results feed back into the loop exactly as with a hosted model.

steps.content: same mechanism, other doors: -m picks the model, -p/--profile layers $CODEX_HOME/<name>.config.toml to pin a provider per environment
steps.annotation: -m overrides the model for one run; a named profile can fix a provider and wire_api for CI vs. laptop without editing the base file.

steps.content: Validation added and tests pass -- all served by the local Ollama model.
steps.annotation: Swapping the provider and wire_api reroutes the model traffic; the agent loop is untouched.
